summary.headline: Aries and Taurus in Astrology
summary.text: Astrological descriptions of Aries and Taurus, including their elemental and meteorological qualities, stellar counts, associated constellations, rising and setting stars, and geographical correspondences. Taurus is further characterized through its degrees, planetary and divine associations, and effects such as pestilence, earthquakes, and lightning.
